speech_native_agent_executor_basis: 2026-09-08, owner Decision 12-F item #9. This fragment reached the legacy contact-DAG executor by declaring nothing at all; the silent default is now a refusal (core.driver.speech_native.build_speech_native_profile), so the executor is named rather than inferred and this cell can state which harness produced its number. The value is 'legacy-contact-dag-v1' and not 'openjiuwen-workflow-v1' because the openJiuwen speech-native executor is an M1/M2 one-or-two-contact vertical slice and this cell's matcher policy and contact ceiling do not compose into it -- re-pointing it would refuse it, not port it. Its successor is a phase program on core.flight.FlightRuntime, as configs/baseline/slurp-phase-direct-only-v1.json already demonstrates for the simplest of these.
